title: JX3 绝境战场 — UI process explorer
source: docs/netcode/JX3_MODE_UI_INVENTORY.md (evidence: PakV4 ui/ config, string tables, protocol layouts)

stages.title: 1. 排队 Queue
stages.summary: 排队面板与队列追踪窗口。单人/组队/房间三种队列，飞沙与周奖励展示，排队中匹配状态与取消。

windows.title: NewBattleFieldQueue
windows.summary: 1,129 sections. The mode tab strip is not authored as a strip: ShowModeTabs (NewBattleFieldQueue.decompiled.lua:4374-4451) hides every tab, then shows only the battlefield ids bound to the entry point and pins them at SetRelX(18 + i*100). InitWndBattleField (lua:4713-4744) drops modes whose IsActivityOn is false, which is why the live queue window shows 五人模式/单人模式/寻宝模式/自定义模式 (乱武模式 676 is off). Visibility follows the engine's LockShowAndHide flag (KGUI decoder clears the visible flag of locked sections; the window script is the only thing that shows them), so locked state widgets stay hidden and the script-shown ones (tabs, activity badges) are listed. The 五人模式 tab handler also sets Text_SkillTitle to STR_DESERTSTORM_TITLE (lua:4477-4488) and Text_TIP_DSTime to the schedule (lua:4350-4372). The reference screenshot state (proof/minimap/screenshots/Screenshot-given-1.png) additionally pins the 赛季 tab badges (Image_AnniversaryIcon1/2/3 at frame 23 of PartnerTeam.UITex, UpdateAnniversaryTabIcon lua:6506-6553; the INI default frame 21 is 周年), the player sample values (个人评分 1873, 飞沙令 10000/10000 via inventory `texts`), and the window's own string table string_ArenaCorpsPanel.txt, whose committed UTF-8 copy in Data/text resolves the labels the generic string.txt lacks.
elements: Handle_FEISHA / Text_AllNum / Text_WeekNum / Text_MyScore — 飞沙 currency
Bool_CreateRoom / JoinRoom / StartGame / DisbandRoom / ExitRoom — room dialogs

windows.title: MapQueue
windows.summary: Per-map queue rows with elapsed time, cancel menu and the auto-enter checkbox; fed by OnSyncMapQueueInfo. Handle_Content/_0 are parked prototypes cloned per queued map by AppendItemFromIni into Handle_List, so the default hides them and injects one authored row. UpdateListSize (MapQueue.decompiled.lua:667-745) resizes the list/bg/checkbox from the row count and then calls Collapse (lua:330-376), which sets the window to 32 + rows*48 + 32 (112 for one row) and shows Wnd_List; the inventory adjust list carries those one-row values.
elements: Per-map queue rows + 点击取消排队 context menu
自动进入 checkbox (silent entry when match found)

stages.title: 2. 匹配成功 / 接受 Match found
stages.summary: 匹配成功后弹出确认（勾选自动进入则直接进入），确认即发送 C→S 0x116。

windows.title: MessageBox (MB_entermap)

appends.text: 你要传送到"龙门绝境"地图吗？

windows.summary: The queue match-found prompt is the engine's generic KGUI MessageBox (ui/Config/Default/MessageBox/MessageBox.ini), opened as MB_entermap by the compiled ui/script/module.lua ComfirmEnterQueuedMap handler. Body = FormatString(STR_SWITCHMAP_GFZ_TIP, map) = 你要传送到"<map>"地图吗？; option 1 = STR_HOTKEY_SURE (确定) with nCountDownTime=30 rendered through MSG_BRACKET <D0>(<D1>) = 确定(30); option 2 = STR_HOTKEY_CANCEL (取消). The script appends the body to Handle_Message (AppendItemFromString, font 18), fills Text_Option1/2, hides the 不再提示 checkbox (no tCheckBoxConfig) and Btn_Close (no bShowClose), and fnAutoClose auto-confirms when the 30 s run out. Layout replays MessageBox.lua:829-842 for this state: body 205px -> content 226x83, window 226x103, panel (Image_Bg/Glassmorphism) 282x103, option row at y=55 with buttons at x=20/118 (10px gap), ornaments anchored to Image_Bg. The static render uses the 龙门绝境 sample (maps 296/297, MapList.tab) at the first countdown frame; the ids come from the global g_tStrings lib ui/String/string.lua (extracted by tools/ui/extract_lua_string_table.py).

stages.title: 3. 过图 Loading
stages.summary: 过图载入：琉璃 KGUI LoadingPanel 全屏覆盖（每张绝境地图一张加载画，进度条在屏幕底部 89.4% 处）+ X3DEngine 原生 GDI KWindowsLoadingWnd 兜底（18 张随机背景），等 ComfirmSyncMapProgress 握手。

windows.title: LoadingPanel
windows.summary: Full-screen loading overlay for a map transfer, 1280x720. One viewer entry with the Page selector switching the destination map (296 龙门绝境 / 297 龙门绝境·夜 / 410 沧溟绝境 / 512 白龙绝境 / 532 天原绝境): Image_Bg = the map's own [loading] image art (CDN _mb PNG, full-bleed 1284x722 at -3,-1), Handle_Traffic and Handle_PakV4Msg hidden (normal map load; the traffic bar and the PakV4 download tips show only while the client is streaming resources), progress bar at (10% w, 89.4% h) with an 80%-wide track and a 912px fill, message/tip handles at (128,646), tip panel at (655,115) — all from LoadingPanel.lua CorrectShow/ShowProgress. Map art pulled from the CDN hpkg with tools/netcode/extract_hpkg_member.py.
elements: Normal progress bar Handle_Nor/Image_Progress (traffic bar hidden)

stages.title: 4. 入场 / 等待开局 Staging
stages.summary: 落地在安全区等待 30 秒级倒计时（数值由服务器下发），使用模式专属站姿；倒计时结束后起飞/开战。

windows.title: Staging countdown (no KGUI renderer)
windows.cn: 开局倒计时 / 安全区
windows.summary: Decoded 2026-09-29: the phase clock exists (S2C 0x11B writes the absolute end time to +0x1b490; GetBattleFieldPQInfo returns it) but its only KGUI consumer, BattleFieldMap.UpdateTime -> Wnd_Title/Text_Time, is hidden in this mode: BattleFieldMap.Init hides Text_Time when IsInTreasureBattleFieldMap() is true (decompiled 1352-1359) and the treasure table covers 296/297/410/512/532/645/676/677/709/715 (CheckTreasureBattleFieldMap dump). The countdown frame UI_黑山绝境_倒计时通用底框.pss is an editor/runtime effect (no extracted INI references it). The safe-zone boundary on the M-map is engine-drawn: InitMapData shows Handle_CircleNew + Handle_StormLine and registers MapCircle with SFX_CircleNew (C_自己圈范围_677.pss) for treasure maps (decompiled 5317-5341) — no KGUI image renderer. Staging announcements are server system messages (observed at T-30/20/10 in interface addon configs, LOW).
evidence: interface MY#DATA team_mon countdown entries 绝境将在30/20/10秒后开始 (LOW, interface-addon)
elements: Phase clock cache +0x1b490 (absolute end time, server value)
BattleFieldMap Wnd_Title/Text_Time — hidden in this mode
Countdown frame PSS (editor/runtime effect, not extracted)
Staging pose animation set 龙门绝境_站姿01..05 (world, not UI)

stages.title: 5. 对局 HUD In-match
stages.summary: 小地图（含风暴圈与安全区外警告）、战场地图（风暴线/圈）、BR 动态技能栏、拾取窗口、统计面板、消息行、队友与增益。

windows.title: MiddleMap
windows.summary: Full-screen map window (M) showing the battlefield map — pages 296/297/410/512/532 (MapList.tab BATTLE_FIELD rows 龙门绝境, 龙门绝境·夜, 沧溟绝境, 白龙绝境, 天原绝境), each page taking its art from that map's minimap pack (龙门寻宝/龙门寻宝_夜晚/海岛绝境/白龙绝境/天原绝境 minimap_mb middlemap.png, 2048x1792; the pack's minimap/config.ini [middlemap0] image=middlemap.png, width/height 1024x896) drawn into Image_Map at the authored 928x812 rect (928/2048 = 0.453 — MiddleMap.UpdateMapPos :9263-9320 fits the art preserving the config aspect; the inset art matches the packs at corr 0.98+); shared by every scene type: Wnd_NormalMap (world map: region list/quest/NPC search), Wnd_CommandMap (war-sandbox command map), explore panels and the battlefield layers under Handle_Total (storm line, camp counts, events) plus WndContainer_GFInfo/HeatMapDetail. The viewer state is a composite of the two windows the client shows: WorldMap drawn behind (WorldMap_ShowBehindMiddleMap(false, true) — MiddleMap.decompiled.lua:22298, WorldMap.decompiled.lua:8314-8356 — hides the WorldMap map scroll/list and keeps its band/chrome) and MiddleMap on top. The overlay replays the WorldMap glass top band (the capture shows no HousePVP band-gradient art — those images stay script-locked), Text_Title 地图, the Handle_TipsTitle zone legend (停战区/保护区/争夺区/战争区/秘境区), CheckBox_Footprint 神行足迹, Wnd_SearchASetting (WndEdit $Placeholder 城镇或秘境) and Btn_Close; MiddleMap replays the translucent MapWindow3/4 bg tiles (Handle_Bg_0!/Handle_Mbg) + Handle_Map/Image_Map (the map area masked by Handle_Border's ShapTexture ui/Image/UItimate/UIMask/MapMask.tga, AlphaShap=1 — a soft 100x80 rounded-rect alpha stretched over the 936x764 border, applied by the viewer as a container OpacityMask so the art feathers into the glass like the capture), the 地图/探索 tabs, the list rows (Text_WM 世界 = STRING_TITLE_WORLDMAP; Text_SmallMap = Table_GetMiddleMap(id).MiddleMap0 per page = 龙门绝境/龙门绝境·夜/沧溟绝境/白龙绝境/天原绝境; Wnd_Region hidden — every battlefield row has Region=0 and UpateRegionBtn :11989-11995 returns, so the capture's 陇右 row is world-map state; Wnd_SmallMaps adjusted to (left 0, top 0) — with the region row hidden the list stacks at the container top right under the 世界 row (authored 53/161 is the parked prototype; left 6 left the map crest/text ~6 px right; the engine's FormatAllContentPos re-format is not reproduced); Image_MapLogo adjusted to top 4 because the authored top -6 draws the crest ~10 px above the capture, which centers it on Text_SmallMap (box correlation +11 px before, +0 after; capture 5.1 Example.png, measured 2026-09-30); the selected 龙门荒漠 row shows Image_BgSelect (MapWindow6 frame 7 — ink RGB (93,131,103) matches the capture's bar (91,118,100), not frame 33's (50,95,88)), so the viewer hides Image_BgNormal/Image_BgOn and places Image_BgSelect at top 5 (authored -5 puts the bar's bottom edge 10 px above the capture's; same runtime row-placement fit as the crest), the bar now aligning at +3/+1 px like the rest of the list), no NPC filter rows: all five packs ship an empty minimap/npc.tab (0 bytes) and no doodad.tab, so UpdateNpcDoodad :5978-6043 appends nothing (the capture's ten rows 地图内交通…碑铭 and its 跨地图交通/其他商人 checks are the world map 龙门荒漠's 33-row npc.tab and the player's saved StorageServer MiddleMap_SelectNpc filter — world state; Image_NpcOption frame 0 checked / 4 unchecked, :501-504, when a page ever carries rows). The trunk rows (Handle_NpcTrunk/Handle_CraftTrunk, cloned from Handle_Mode by UpdateAreaOrNpcList :5660-5705) are hidden on the battlefield pages — an empty list shows no title and the packs carry no rows (the capture's world state shows them because its 龙门荒漠 pack has rows); when a page carries rows the trunk art is the Image_ListBg1/Bg2 eye (MapWindow6 frame 32 open / 35 closed; UpdateAreaOrNpcTruckState :4501-4592 swaps them with the expand state), with the authored-visible Image_ListCover (frame 30 magnifier) and Image_Minimize hidden (list-template hide). The NPC list scrollbar (Scroll_List) is hidden as well — the capture shows no scrollbar (its list fits; ours is empty). Image_Search is diced (adjust imageType 10): the client draws the 20x20 Common frame 0 box art with 1 px borders although the INI omits ImageType — the stretched render showed a 13 px left/right band (the extra-dusted area), the capture 1 px. Also replayed: the 标记设置 button and the scale/alpha sliders. The window is placed 27 px below the WorldMap band (inventory `offsetY`; the WorldMap stays at the client top) — the capture shows the 地图 tab underline at y=113 and the list/bottom bar/art ~+27 vs the authored positions; the runtime NPC title row is 43 px tall (inventory `adjust Handle_Mode`; the authored 54 is the editor height — with it the panel rows land at the capture's 228.6/266.9), and the tab state is the script's: `CheckBox_MapPage` checked (inventory `images.checked`; the capture paints the selected frame, the script calls `Check(true)` :20817/20942) and `CheckBox_ExplorePage` hidden (the script hides it when `GetMapExploreInfo(mapID)` is empty :3920-3958; the capture shows no 探索 tab). WndContainer_GFInfo is hidden (UpdateHeatMapState :25045-25081 hides it when CanShowHeatMap() is false), and only the parked data-marker layers (person/teammate, born/treasure/event marks, draw/storm lines, area name, traffic, quest/NPC marks), the command-mode/quest-filter subtrees and the script-locked widgets (Wnd_CommandMap, CheckBox_QuestPage, Btn_Close, WndContainer_HeatMapDetail) stay hidden.

windows.title: MiniMap
windows.cn: 小地图 / 战场入口按钮
windows.summary: Top-right lens with the battlefield button, observer button, storm circle range hint and outside-safe-zone warning options. The INI parks the lens at Left=-200 (the slide-in start); the module's UpdateAnchorCorner (Minimap.decompiled.lua:1542-1770) sets the TOPRIGHT corner layout: Wnd_Corner (27,0), Wnd_Minimap (0,32), CheckBox_Switch (205,-2), Image_Coner (153,0) — replayed in `adjust`. The slide-out side panels stay parked at negative X (their module animates them in).
elements: Storm circle overlays + outside-zone flashing warning

windows.title: BattleFieldMap
windows.summary: Draggable M-map panel with the 龙门绝境 sample map art (same extracted middlemap.png) in Image_Map. When IsInTreasureBattleFieldMap() it shows Handle_StormLine and registers MapCircle/SFX_CircleNew; heat map toggle; mark/gain/sfx notify events.

windows.title: DynamicBattleRoyale
windows.summary: The mode's skill bar: fixed default skills plus dynamic boxes for picked-up skills, driven by nDynamicSkillNum / nCanDragCount.

windows.title: PVPShowPanel
windows.summary: In-match statistics table fed by GetBattleFieldStatistics + PQ_STATISTICS_INDEX slices (INJURY / HARM_OUTPUT / TREAT_OUTPUT / SPECIAL_OP_7). UpdatePos (PVPShowPanel.lua:155-183) anchors the team HP lists to LEFTCENTER/RIGHTCENTER and the player info to BOTTOMCENTER at runtime; the inventory anchors replay that.
elements: Per-player rows: name / kills / damage / healing

windows.title: LootList
windows.summary: Container loot window (OnSyncLootList), pickup bar (拾取/打开/操作), smart-loot and filter options; MaxLootRange = 5.

windows.title: FightingNum
windows.summary: Number HUD candidates (kills / remaining). The storm countdown and remaining-players renderer (STR_TIMEDESERT / STR_LEFTPEPLE) is still unlocated; this panel is the closest extracted candidate.

windows.title: FightingStatistic
windows.summary: Statistics rows used by the scoreboard-side UI; feeds from the same statistics records as PVPShowPanel.

windows.title: MainMessageLine
windows.summary: System message line (SYS_MSG); carries the mode announcements (e.g. the streamer-mode warning STR_STORM3) and event calls.

windows.title: BuffList / DebuffList / TargetBuff
windows.summary: Standard buff/debuff UI; the storm/zone state arrives as a server-synced buff (no official local storm buff row found).

windows.title: Teammate / TeamBuff
windows.summary: Squad frames used by the mode (5-player squads in the original design); battlefield side drives nameplate colour.

stages.title: 6. 死亡 / 复活 Death
stages.summary: 受重伤/濒危状态，复活请求 C→S 0xB9；天原冰封复活与流萤魂返花等模式复活手段。

windows.title: RevivePanel
windows.summary: Located in PakV4 as ui/Config/Default/RevivePanel.ini (43 sections, DesertStorm3 + RevivePanel atlases). BR death/revive prompt driven by C->S 0xB9 DoPlayerReviveRequest.
elements: 天原冰封复活 skill 31507 / 流萤魂返花 item

stages.title: 7. 结算 Settlement
stages.summary: PVPShowFinal 结算面板（左右两列玩家行），由 BATTLE_FIELD_SYNC_STATISTICS 驱动，展示击伤/伤害/治疗/濒危与奖励。

windows.title: PVPShowFinal
windows.summary: Panel frame; the Lua driver registers BATTLE_FIELD_SYNC_STATISTICS -> OnSyncPQ -> GetBattleFieldStatistics, then MergeData/UpdateList; opens with ApplyBattleFieldStatistics. The Handle_Player* rows parked at the window edge are item prototypes cloned at runtime (InitPanel hides the arena score/title; UpdateOneSideList appends rows from PVPShowFinalL/R.ini), so the default state shows the authored row layout via the cloned prototypes instead of the parked originals.

windows.title: PVPShowFinalL
windows.summary: Item prototype INI (not a standalone window): Handle_Player is appended into PVPShowFinal's Handle_FinalListL by AppendItemFromIni. Rendered standalone it shows the parked prototype row.

windows.title: PVPShowFinalR
windows.summary: Item prototype INI (not a standalone window): Handle_Player is appended into PVPShowFinal's Handle_FinalListR by AppendItemFromIni (StringTable=ui/Scheme/Case/string_PVPAcount.txt).

stages.title: 8. 离开 / 退出 Exit
stages.summary: 小地图菜单离开战场、排队取消确认与 LEAVE_BATTLE_FIELD 事件。

windows.title: ExitPanel
windows.summary: Located in PakV4 as ui/Config/Default/ExitPanel.ini (15 sections, CommonPanel2/PanelBg atlases). The leave-battlefield confirm menu (LEAVE_BATTLE_FIELD event).
